title: Geostationary Full-Disk Imagery
description: Full-disk Level 1b radiance and reflectance imagery from the GOES, Himawari, and GK-2A geostationary weather satellites, reformatted from public AWS archives into cloud-optimized Zarr arrays managed as Icechunk repositories. Provides historical through near-real-time observations of the full Earth disk.
